Author: Drovolon
Name: Pulsar
Description: A plugin to sync sound files. /pulsar to open config. Requires a compatible sync plugin, like Lightless.
Punchline: A plugin to sync sound files.
TestingChangelog: This adds support for 'playlists' in DAM mods implemented via option groups in Penumbra. There's also a new config setting to auto-mute BGM when listening or broadcasting (defaults to enabled).
